title: Primakov proposes that the SVR keep Arafat alive and the CIA keep Rabin alive
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Primakov proposes that the SVR keep Arafat alive and the CIA keep Rabin alive, about 1993 at Moscow, Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> "Our goal will be to keep Arafat alive. Your goal will be to keep Rabin alive."

plain: A former senior officer of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, recalls a meeting in Moscow around 1993 with a senior Russian official, Yevgeny Primakov. According to Mowatt-Larssen, Primakov proposed a deal: the SVR, Russia's foreign intelligence service, would work to keep Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat alive, while the CIA would work to keep Israeli prime minister Yitzhak Rabin alive. If true, it shows the two rival spy services quietly cooperating to protect the Middle East peace effort.
